company_devices_pending_token_shape_chec.name: company_devices_pending_token_shape_check
company_devices_pending_token_shape_chec.value:
(
    ("company_devices"."pending_token_hash" is null and "company_devices"."pending_token_version" is null)
    or ("company_devices"."pending_token_hash" is not null and "company_devices"."pending_token_version" is not null and "company_devices"."pending_token_version" > "company_devices"."current_token_version")
  )

member_executor_assignments_switch_shape.name: member_executor_assignments_switch_shape_check
member_executor_assignments_switch_shape.value:
(
      ("member_executor_assignments"."state" = 'switching'
        and "member_executor_assignments"."pending_executor_id" is not null
        and "member_executor_assignments"."previous_executor_id" is not null
        and "member_executor_assignments"."switch_operation_id" is not null)
      or
      ("member_executor_assignments"."state" <> 'switching'
        and "member_executor_assignments"."pending_executor_id" is null
        and "member_executor_assignments"."previous_executor_id" is null
        and "member_executor_assignments"."switch_operation_id" is null)
    )

room_messages_sender_shape_check.name: room_messages_sender_shape_check
room_messages_sender_shape_check.value:
(
      ("room_messages"."sender_type" = 'system' and "room_messages"."sender_member_id" is null)
      or ("room_messages"."sender_type" <> 'system' and "room_messages"."sender_member_id" is not null)
    )
